content.en: The **Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme** aims to boost domestic manufacturing by offering financial rewards to companies for achieving specific production targets. Unlike traditional subsidies, these incentives are **performance-linked**, meaning they are disbursed only after the manufacturer achieves incremental sales over a base year. This approach shifts the focus from mere capacity creation to actual output and value addition, aligning with the broader goal of making India a **global manufacturing hub**.

definition.en: Incentives are calculated based on the growth in sales of manufactured goods compared to a defined base year.
